previousRule: My Home checkout regression coverage did not verify that anonymous cushion and motorised-track orders can persist under a guest-owned checkout attempt, or that cushion-only delivery can be quoted without a postcode. Production order persistence required a signed-in customer, while the shared order screen asked for a postcode even for fixed-rate cushion delivery.
newRule: Keep saved Cushion Studio designs account-only, while My Home cushion and motorised-track purchases use a shop-scoped random checkout attempt. Cushion-only reviews and checkout use the fixed quoted delivery charge without a postcode; curtain and track delivery remain governed by postcode. Test guest persistence, account-only saved-design ownership, legacy signed-in attempt compatibility and cushion-only delivery identity.
reason: Shopify permits guest checkout, and cushion delivery has a fixed £4.95 charge. The new tests protect the narrower My Home guest path and remove a redundant cushion-only checkout step without weakening pricing, purchase, delivery, or payment validation.
ownerApprovedDecision: The owner approved the guest-checkout alternative and asked to simplify the cushion checkout journey. This record describes protected regression tests; the exact-head Nylon1 approval comment required by the protected production policy is still pending.
